preface:
## 4. Complete revised working script — v0.2

Square brackets are staging and implementation notes, not spoken dialogue. Chapter result inserts are alternatives: play only the one matching the hand. All routes rejoin the shared scene. The script is fully playable without voice recordings. Profanity is the default draft voice, with the existing clean-language option retained for implementation.

blocks.raw: RAFA: “The guests were promised a fair game. Sit down, Tomás.”
blocks.speaker: RAFA
blocks.text: “The guests were promised a fair game. Sit down, Tomás.”

blocks.raw: [They sit. Evidence already delivered; inspection and custodians already protect the site. The table keeps the dispute public while the board representative arrives. A hand's result does not grant rights or decide consequences.]
[DEAL: Partnership. Rafa plays honestly as Vale's partner. Personal solidarity is not signaled through secret moves or deliberate losses.]
Optional table exchanges, placed between moves:
- VALE: “I donated to that neighborhood table.” RAFA: “You did. I thanked you. I didn't sell it to you.”
- VALE: “How many people have you employed?” MARISOL: “How many are allowed to tell you the truth?”
- COUSIN: “Good move, partner.” MARISOL: “Try sounding less surprised.” COUSIN: “That was admiration. Different expression.”
- VALE, after an ordinary pass: “Someone should be able to open this.” RAFA: “Someone could. We play by the rules.”
**Win insert:** COUSIN: “¡Dominó! No more tiles.” MARISOL: “Still plenty to discuss.”
**Loss insert:** VALE: “You see? In the end—” MARISOL: “You won a hand, Tomás. Finish the sentence carefully.”
**Tie insert:** RAFA: “Blocked. We count what everybody's holding.” [Marisol looks at Vale.] MARISOL: “For once.”

[Common continuation. The board representative arrives with the resort's compliance lead; these roles can appear as text and off-camera voices. A work-stop confirmation from the independent inspection team is visible.]
REPRESENTATIVE: “Mr. Vale, the contractor has acknowledged the stop. Your access is suspended pending investigation. We'll need the original authorizations.”
blocks.speaker: REPRESENTATIVE
blocks.text: “Mr. Vale, the contractor has acknowledged the stop. Your access is suspended pending investigation. We'll need the original authorizations.”

blocks.raw: VALE: “These are internal operational decisions.”
blocks.speaker: VALE

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “Then you shouldn't have needed my signature.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL
blocks.text: “Then you shouldn't have needed my signature.”

blocks.raw: REPRESENTATIVE: “Ms. Vélez's suspension is rescinded. The override trail and report will be preserved under the review. Site access remains with the custodians and inspection team.”
blocks.speaker: REPRESENTATIVE
blocks.text: “Ms. Vélez's suspension is rescinded. The override trail and report will be preserved under the review. Site access remains with the custodians and inspection team.”

blocks.raw: [Vale looks to Roberto for a private exit from the exchange. Roberto does not offer one.]
VALE: “You'll regret making an enemy over this.”
blocks.speaker: VALE
blocks.text: “You'll regret making an enemy over this.”

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “You made an enemy when you decided her life was spare equipment.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN
blocks.text: “You made an enemy when you decided her life was spare equipment.”

blocks.raw: [Vale is escorted away from the event, angry and still accountable to a continuing investigation. No instant conviction or magical disappearance.]
[Marisol sits again. The effort of staying composed catches up with her. Roberto waits before reaching across the table. She takes his hand.]
COUSIN: “You okay?”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “Not completely.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “Okay. We can work with honest.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: [She recognizes her own words and smiles.]
RAFA: “I'd like to say I always knew he was trouble.”
blocks.speaker: RAFA
blocks.text: “I'd like to say I always knew he was trouble.”

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “Did you?”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: RAFA: “I knew enough to ask more questions. I liked the donation. I didn't like the discomfort.”
blocks.speaker: RAFA
blocks.text: “I knew enough to ask more questions. I liked the donation. I didn't like the discomfort.”

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “You showed up when it counted.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: RAFA: “I'm showing up earlier next time.”
blocks.speaker: RAFA

blocks.raw: [Luz's message arrives: work stopped, overnight watch arranged, water recovering. A short attached field clip shows a steady waterfall; no mysterious voice on demand.]
MARISOL: “They offered my job back.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “You want it?”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “I want a day where that isn't the first question.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL
blocks.text: “I want a day where that isn't the first question.”

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “I know a place with terrible coffee.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN
blocks.text: “I know a place with terrible coffee.”

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “Good company?”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “Excellent references.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

scenes.title: Someone Left a Light On
scenes.location: Neighborhood patio, Day 2 later that evening, reused with a night grade. No additional hand.

blocks.raw: **Location:** Neighborhood patio, Day 2 later that evening, reused with a night grade. No additional hand.
[A simple dinner has been interrupted by neither a laptop nor a case folder. The domino box is closed. Roberto reaches for his phone when it buzzes, then decides not to.]
MARISOL: “Could be another terrible decision.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “Office hours are over.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “I thought you didn't have office hours.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL
blocks.text: “I thought you didn't have office hours.”

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “New management.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: [She laughs. The repaired fan moves the edge of a napkin.]
MARISOL: “You ever think about what you want when nobody needs fixing?”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL
blocks.text: “You ever think about what you want when nobody needs fixing?”

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “Working out. Writing code nobody asked for. Arguing with Saturn.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN
blocks.text: “Working out. Writing code nobody asked for. Arguing with Saturn.”

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “I said what you want.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: [He looks at her, letting the answer be simple.]
COUSIN: “More evenings like this.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “You could've asked.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: COUSIN: “I'm asking.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: [She moves her chair closer.]
MARISOL: “Then yes.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: [She touches his jaw, giving him a moment to meet her halfway. They kiss. Keep it warm, brief, and unhurried.]
[A knock at the gate. They separate just enough to exchange an exasperated smile.]
COUSIN: “If that's Rafa, I'm charging him.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: [No one stands outside. A shallow line of water lies beneath the gate. It ends before their chairs. Three soft knocks come from the closed domino box. A fourth answers from beyond the lit doorway.]
[Marisol takes Roberto's hand. He does not reach for a weapon, collect a tile, or step into the dark.]
MARISOL: “Is it asking again?”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL

blocks.raw: [He looks toward the doorway. The light stays on.]
COUSIN: “I think it knows we heard.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: MARISOL: “You don't have to answer every call tonight.”
blocks.speaker: MARISOL
blocks.text: “You don't have to answer every call tonight.”

blocks.raw: [He sits back beside her.]
COUSIN: “Table's closed.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: [A beat. His familiar grin returns, with less armor behind it.]
COUSIN: “Tomorrow? Fuck it. We'll see.”
blocks.speaker: COUSIN

blocks.raw: [The water goes still. Cut to title, then credits. Case complete. No compulsory sequel chapter.]
